items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: Buddy Collette, Bud Shank, Tom Scott, all those guys, Bobby Bryant on trumpet... So that was just kind of his normal set of people to play his music.

ctx.x: I get such a charge out of still reading the personnel on music that came out of Los Angeles at that time. And you just — I mean I write arrangements too and I sometimes think oh my God if I could have that assemblage of people and have them play a chart of mine, that would be like so incredible.

Oh yeah. And this was normal stuff for him. I mean Buddy Collette, Bud Shank, Tom Scott, all those guys, Bobby Bryant on trumpet. I mean Garnett Brown on trombone, Shelly Manne played with them all the time. Ray Brown played with him a whole bunch of the time. So that was just kind of his normal set of people to play his music.
Would he come home and talk about his day?
